prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Sugar Land, Texas, and has whiplash. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1445; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement is about the sideswipe collision you were involved in while changing lanes in Sugar Land, Texas. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Please state where you were driving and what you were doing right before the impact.

A: I was in the right lane on a four-lane road, heading toward the highway. I checked my mirror, signaled, and started moving into the left lane to get around a slow truck.

Q: When you moved over, what did you see?

A: I glanced over my shoulder and thought the lane was clear, but a silver sedan came up from behind me and clipped the side of my car. I felt the jolt and my car pulled slightly to the right.

Q: Did you or the other driver stop after the contact?

A: Yes, we both pulled onto the shoulder. The other driver got out and we exchanged information right away.

Q: Did you feel any injury at the scene?

A: Not right away. I was shaken up, but I figured I was fine. By that evening my neck was stiff and the pain started spreading into my shoulders. It got worse over the next day or two.

Q: Have you sought medical care since the collision?

A: Yes, I saw my doctor and I've been going to physical therapy twice a week. The doctor said it looks like whiplash from the sudden jerk of the impact.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add about the accident?

A: Only that I was careful with my signal and mirror check. I just didn't expect the car to come up so fast.

Q: Thank you. That concludes the statement.

A: Thank you.
